standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-lift-maps (delivered card L48358): item 1 restricts automorphisms to normal subextensions; item 2 extends K-maps into a normal extension to automorphisms
Chapter lemma-galois-profinite (delivered card L48328): part (1) is the universal property of the profinite topology, characterizing continuity of group maps through continuity of the action
Chapter section setup: Gal(L over K) carries the Krull topology, for which the action Gal(L over K) x L to L is continuous
core_obligations: For tau in Gal(L over K), the restriction tau restricted to M lands in Gal(M over K) by lift-maps item 1 (M over K normal), and the map c so defined is a group homomorphism definitionally
Continuity: the action of Gal(L over K) on M is the restriction of the continuous action on L, and part (1) of the profinite lemma upgrades continuity of the action to continuity of c
Surjectivity: any tau_M in Gal(M over K) is a K-algebra map from M into the normal extension L, so lift-maps item 2 extends it to an automorphism of L whose restriction is tau_M
proof_roadmap: Define the restriction homomorphism through the lift lemma
Close continuity by the profinite universal property and surjectivity by extension
